name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
description: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric role-playing game, an enhanced edition of 2000's Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn.

eax.problem: This is the Enhanced Edition, not the classic Baldur's Gate II, and it has no EAX.

notes: Boulders Gate II complete, a separate purchase on GOG, is the original 2000 release that still supports EAX.
